title: Grade an agent result using evidence and explicit limitations
prompt: Review an agent report that claims completion but has one required check marked NOT_RUN and no runtime transcript. Produce an evidence-based evaluation verdict.
preconditions: Run in a trusted Codex session with the report and its claimed check evidence available.
expected_behaviors: Assess each criterion with an explicit status and evidence reference.
Keep NOT_RUN or BLOCKED distinct from PASS.
Derive the overall verdict using the documented critical-failure and incomplete-check rules.
State the absence of runtime evidence as a limitation and define the next verification step.
must_not: Do not award PASS because the report says complete.
Do not hide an unrun required check in an aggregate score.
expected_artifacts: An evaluation record with criterion statuses, evidence references, overall status, and limitations.
